description: RNAplfold accuracy comparison against Raccess Exact, on the same 12,872 bpRNA sequences (100-1,000nt) and window lengths w in {1,3,7,10} used for Table 1 and Figure 2. Supports Results §3.2's RNAplfold column in Table 1: RNAplfold computes the same conceptual quantity (window-unpaired probability) via local sliding-window folding averaged over every window containing the region, a different algorithm from Raccess Window's single global ensemble with a span cutoff.

tool.name: RNAplfold
tool.source: module load ViennaRNA/2.7.2 (HPC module system; not vendored in this repository)

input.description: The same 12,872-sequence subset of bpRNA_1m_90_filtered_clean.fa used throughout Table 1 and Figure 2, extracted by sequence ID from benchmark/data/bprna_100_1000_list.txt.

settings.note_on_settings: W=100 and L=100 match Raccess Window's W=100 span limit; u=10 matches the paper's longest tested window length (w in {1,3,7,10}).

execution.method: Split the 12,872-sequence FASTA into 16 chunks and ran RNAplfold once per chunk (it natively accepts multi-FASTA input via stdin, emitting one <seq_id>_lunp file per record), in parallel background processes on a single interactive node rather than through qsub.
execution.reason_not_qsub: qsub array-job submission of this repository's benchmark scripts has a known, unresolved, repo-external permission failure on this cluster (see docs/todo_p0_p1_20260915.md); the established workaround is to run directly instead of through qsub. RNAplfold's per-sequence cost is low enough (~0.3s/seq at these settings) that a direct 16-way parallel run on one node completed the full 12,872-sequence set in a few minutes.
execution.script: benchmark/scripts/uge/rnaplfold_comparison.sh (invoked directly per chunk with TASK_ID set manually, not via qsub)

outputs.lunp_files: benchmark/results/rnaplfold_w100_u10/lunp/ (12,872 files, gitignored as regenerable raw output)
outputs.parsed_comparison: benchmark/scripts/rnaplfold_compare.py reads the _lunp files and benchmark/results/bprna_accuracy_comparison/exact/ (already-frozen Raccess Exact evidence, reused unchanged) and writes summary.json

lunp_format_note: Each _lunp row i (1-indexed), column l gives the probability that positions [i-l+1, i] (1-indexed, inclusive) are all unpaired. Converted to this repository's 0-indexed start-anchored (start, length) convention as start_0idx = i - l to match parse_raccess/parse_linracc's shape.
